events.text: JoshMemory Record: Corrected AIDungeonMaster historical reference to commit c335532. Checked PR #7, CI test check failed due to a pre-existing linting issue unrelated to the ReDoS fix. Diagnosed 403s on GitHub using gh auth status; discovered multiple accounts authenticated locally. Successfully used gh auth switch -u to switch between joshparri and joshualparris to push both AvanceProfessionalDevelopment (PR #3 opened) and ashfaller (PR #1 opened). Durably preserved SecurityAudit locally by initializing a git repository, configuring .gitignore for sensitive json data, and committing PORTFOLIO_RISK_REGISTER.md and parse_and_synthesize.py.
